v: avapASita
tri॰ avapASaH samantAt pASojAto'syatAra॰ itac । pASabadDe “paSyAmyEva hi kaRWetvAM kAlapASAvapASitam” rA॰
m: अव-पाशित mfn. having a snare laid upon, snared, R. iii, 59, 18 and vii, 6, 59.
a: अवपाशित — a. [अवपाशः समंतात् पाशो जातोऽस्य तार˚ इतच्] Snared, having a snare laid over (on all sides); पश्याम्यैव हि कंठे त्वां कालपाशावपाशितं Rām.

v: avapAda
pu॰ ava + pada--GaY । aDaHpatane “devAvE AdityAH KargAllokAdavapAdAdbiBiyuH” tA॰ brA॰ ।
m: अव-पाद m. falling, TBr.; Kāṭh.

v: avapAka
pu॰ ava + apakarze paca--GaY । apakfzwapAke । karmmaRi GaY । 2 apakfzwapakve । “tvaca utkarttanamavapAkAnAM saMvraScam” Sata॰ brA॰ ।
m: अ-वपा-क mfn. having no omentum (cf. वपा), ŚBr.; KātyŚr.
a: अवपाक — a. 1 Badly or ill-cooked. --2 Without a net. --कः Bad cooking.

m: अव-पान n. drinking, RV. i, 136, 4 and x, 43, 2
a pond or pool for watering, RV. vii, 98, 1; viii, 4, 10 and x, 106, 2.

s: puM, (ava + pat + GaY .) ranDaM । garttaH । iti hemacandraH ॥ aDaHpatanaM ॥ (gajAdInAM grahaRArTaM kftastfRAdinA pracCanno garttaH । yaTA, -- “avapAtastu hastyarTe garttaSCannastfRAdinA” । iti yAdavaH । “roDAMsi niGnannavapAtamagnaH karIva vanyaH paruzaM rarAsa” । iti raGuvaMSe । nAwakAdO BayAdijanitapalAyanasamBramAdivarRanena prastutasya parivarttaH । yaTA, -- “avapAtantu nizkrAma-praveSa-trAsa-vidravEH” । iti daSarUpe .)
v: avapAta

pu॰ ava + pata--BAve GaY । aDaHpatane । pataRic--BAve ac । 2 pAtane “SastrAvapAte garBasya pAtane “cottamodamaH” yA॰ smf॰ । ADAre GaY । 3 gartte “avapAtastu hastyarTe gartte Canne tfRAdinA” iti yAdavokte gajaGAraRArTe 4 garttaBede ca “roDAMsi niGnannavapAtamagnam” raGuH
m: अव-पात m. falling down, Mṛcch.
(अन्- neg.), AitBr. (cf. शस्त्रावप्˚)
descent, descending upon
flying down, Hit.
a hole or pit for catching game in Ragh. xvi, 78
a: अवपातः — 1 Falling down; जलं कूलावपातेन प्रसन्नं कलुषायते Mk. 9. 24; अधश्चरणावपातं Bh. 2. 31 falling down at the feet; (fig.) cringing. --2 Descent, descending; शस्त्रावपातः Y. 2. 277; कपोत˚ H. 1; श्येन˚ चकिता Māl. 8. 8 sudden swoop or pouncing. --3 A hole, pit. --4 Particularly, a hole or pit for catching elephants; अवपातस्तु हस्त्यर्थे गर्ते छन्ने तृणादिना Yādava; रोधांसि निघ्नन्नवपातमग्नः करीव वन्यः परुषं ररास R. 16. 78.

m: अव-पातम् ind. with अव-पत्य (ind.p.), falling or flying down like (in comp.)
अव-पातन n. felling, knocking or throwing down, Mn. xi, 64; Yājñ. ii, 223; BhP.
(in dramatical language) a scene during which a person enters the stage in terror but leaves it at the end in good humour, Sāh.
a: अवपातनं — Felling, knocking down, throwing down; द्रुमाणां Ms. 11. 65; कुड्यावपातनं Y. 2. 223.

v: avapAtra
tri॰ avaraM BojanAyogyaM pAtraM yasya । yasya Bojanena pAtre duzwe'nyasya BojanAyogyatA Bavati tAdfSe patitamlecCAdO jane ।
a: अवपात्र — a. [अवरं भोजनायोग्यं पात्रं यस्य] A Mleccha whose eating in a vessel makes it useless for others.

v: avapAtrita
tri॰ avapAtra + kftyarTe Ric--kta । BinnodakIkfte apapAtritaSabdArTe ।
m: अव-पात्रित mfn. a person not allowed by his kindred to eat or drink from the same vessel (cf. अप-पात्रित.)
a: अवपात्रित — a. [अवपात्र कृत्यर्थे णिच्-क्त] One who has lost his caste, a person not allowed by his kindred to eat in a common vessel; see अपपात्रित (= भिन्नोदकीकृत Dāy. B.).

m: अव-पाटिका f. laceration of the prepuce, Suśr.
अव-√ पीड् (ind.p. -पिड्य) to press down, compress, MBh. i, 6292, (Pot. -पीडयेत्) to press out (as a wound), Suśr.
a: अवपीड् — {c10c} P. To compress; ममज्जेव मही तस्य भूरिभारावपीडिता Mb.; पादौ शिरोभिरवपीडितौ Rām.; to press or squeeze together; एकीकृतस्त्वचि निषिक्त इवावपीड्य Māl. 6. 12.

v: avapIqa

tri॰ avapIqayati ava--pIqa--ac । 1 samantAt pIqake “cikitsAviSeze pu॰ 2 vegAntezu cAvapIqaM dadyAt” suSru॰ “pratimarzo'vapIqaSca nasyaM praSamanaM taTA । SirovirecanaM ceti nastaH karmma ca paYcaDA” iti cakradattokte 3 nAsikAcikitsABede ca । tallakzaRaM tatrEvoktaM yaTA “avapIqya dIyate yasyAdavapIqastatastu saH । SoGanaH stamBanaSca syAdavapIqo dviDA mata” iti ।
m: अव-पीड m. pressing down, Suśr.
one of the five sternutatories or drugs producing sneezing, Suśr.; Bhpr.
a: अवपीड — a. Pressed on all sides. --डः 1 Pressing down, pressure. --2 A kind of medicinal drug used to cause sneezing, sternutatory. --3 A kind of medical treatment.

m: अव-पीडक m. (= -पीड) a sternutatory, Car.
अव-पीडना f. damage, violation, Mn. viii, 287.

v: avapIqana

na॰ ava + pIqa--Ric lyuw । 1 nizpIqane । suSrutokte 2 pIqanadozaBede “atipIqitatA SiTilapIqitatABUyoBUyovapIqanaM kAlAtikrama iti catvAraH pIqanadoDAH” । yuc । avapIqanA nizpIqane strI “aNgAvapIqanAyAYca vraRaSIRitayostaTA” suSru॰ ।
m: अव-पीडन n. the act of pressing down, Suśr.
pressing down (the eye-lids) Comm. on Nyāyad.
a sternutatory, Suśr.
a: अवपीडनं — 1 The act of pressing down. --2 A sternutatory. --ना Damage, violation; Ms. 8. 287.

m: अव-पीडित mfn. pressed down, thrown down, MBh. xiv, 1944
pressed, oppressed, pressed out (as a wound), Suśr.
अव-पूर्ण mfn. filled with (in comp.), Hariv. 11993; VarBṛS.
अव-पूरण n. filling or covering with (comp.), Car.
अव-√ पश् P. -पश्यति (2. pl. -पश्यत; p. -पश्यत्) to look down upon (acc.), RV.; AV. xviii, 4, 37 : Ā. -पश्यते, to look upon, AV. ix, 4, 19.

अव-√ पद् -पद्यते (Subj. P. -पदाति, RV. ix, 73, 9; Prec. Ā. 3. sg. -पदीष्ट, RV. vii, 104, 17; aor. Subj. Ā. 3. sg. -पादि, RV. i, 105, 3; Ved. Inf. (abl.) -पदस्, RV. ii, 29, 6) Ved. to fall down, glide down into (acc.), RV. &c.; (Imper. Ā. 3. pl. -पद्यन्ताम्; Subj. P. 2. sg. -पत्सि; Pot. P. 1. sg. -पद्येयम्) to drop from (abl.), be deprived of (abl.), AV.; AitBr.; PBr.; (Subj. Ā. 1. sg. -पद्यै) to fall, meet with an accident, AitBr.; (fut. 3. pl. -पत्स्यन्ति) to throw down, Kāṭh. : Caus. (Imper. 2. sg. -पादय; ind.p. -पाद्य) to cause to glide or go down, AV.; Suśr.
a: अवपद् — {c4c} A. 1 To go down, glide down; to descend, fall down as केश, गर्भ &c. --2 To be deprived of (with abl.). --3 To fall, meet with an accident. --4 To overthrow, ruin. --Caus. To cause to glide or go down.

m: अ-वपन n. not shaving, PārGṛ.

v: avapanna

tri॰ ava + pada--kta । 1 sasfzwe 2 sahapakve ca “keSakIwAvapannaYca padA spfzwaYca kAmataH” manuH । “avapannaM saMsargadUzitam” kullU॰ । “keSakIwAvapanna ca strIBiHspfzwaM taTEva ca” hArI॰ avapanna sahapakvam prA॰ ta॰ raGa॰ ।
m: अव-पन्न mfn. fallen down, that upon which anything has fallen down, MārkP.
See केश-कीटावप्˚ and कीटावप्˚ ‘fallen down’, see स्वयमवपन्न.
a: अवपन्न — p. p. 1 Mixed with. --2 Cooked together with. --3 Fallen on or into. --4 Alighted, descended.

m: अव-√ पत् (p. -पतत्, RV. x, 97, 17 ind.p. -पत्य See अव-पात; impf. अवापतत्, MBh. &c.) to fly down, jump down, fall down : Caus. (p. -पातयत्) to throw down, Kathās.
a: अवपत् — {c1c} P. To fall down, fly down, jump down, descend, alight, pounce or swoop upon; श्येनावपातमवपत्य Prab.; फलैर्वृक्षावपतितैः Rām. --Caus. To throw down, fell down.

m: अव-पतन n. falling down, (cf. अवरावप्˚.) Jaina Prākṛt ovaḍaṇa See शस्त्रावपात.
अव-पतित mfn. fallen down from (in comp.), R. ii, 28, 12
that upon which anything (in comp.) has fallen down (see केश-कीटावप्˚)
(said of the voice) unclear, (अन्- neg.), Car.
अव-√ पट् (ind.p. -पाट्य) to split, tear into pieces, Suśr.; Kād. Pass. -पाट्यते, to crack, flaw, split, Suśr.
a: अवपट् — {c10c} P. To split. --Pass. To split oneself, to be split.

m: अव-पृष्ठी-कृत or अव-पृष्ठी-भूत, mfn. set on the path of Buddhahood (?), Divyāv.
अव-पिण्डित mfn. (said of dewdrops) fallen down in the shape of little globules (पिण्ड, q.v.), Kathās.
अव-√ पिष् (ind.p. -पिष्य) to crush or grind into pieces, grind, Suśr.
अव-√ प्लु Ā. (perf. -पुप्लुवे) to jump down (as from a cart), MBh. vii, 5196 and 6887.

v: avapluta
tri॰ ava + plu--kta । samantAt sikte 1 ArdraBUte 2 avatIrRRe ca ।
m: अव-प्लुत mfn. plunged into, ĀśvGṛ.
jumped down from, MBh. &c.
gone away from, departed from, MBh. ii, 1452; Hariv. 4760
अव-प्लुत n. jumping down, MBh. ix, 3193.
अव-प्लुत्य ind.p. jumping down, MBh. &c.
jumping away from (abl.), MBh. vii, 568
hastening away or off, Hariv. 15340.
अव-पोथिका f. anything used for knocking down, as stones &c. thrown from the walls of a city on the besiegers, MBh. iii, 641.
अव-पोथित mfn. thrown or knocked down, MBh. vi, 5505; Hariv.
अव-प्रज्जन n. (√ पृज्), the end of the warp of a web (opposed to 2. प्र-वयण, q.v.), AitBr.
a: अवप्रज्जनः — The end of the warp of a web.

m: अव-प्र-स्नुत or अव-प्र-स्रुत, mfn. wetted by the fluid excretion (of a bird), KātyŚr.
अव-√ पुथ् Caus. (p. -पोथयत्; Pot. -पोथयेत्) to throw or knock down, Hariv.
अव-पुञ्जित mfn. collected into small heaps (as sweepings).
अ-वपुस् mfn. bodiless, formless, MBh.
